summary: Arms with Spearing Strike and Improved Bloodrage, for a Giant or Dragonkin boss like Onyxia.
advantage: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin, so it's worth casting.
advantageShort: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin.
rotation: Pre-pull: Battle Stance, then Charge (15 Rage)
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
With 25s left, if Recklessness is ready and Rage is under 25, swap to Berserker Stance. Swap back after Recklessness
Recklessness in the last 25s. Racials on cooldown, but Elune's Light never during Recklessness or the 15s before it
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 15s. Bloodrage under 20 Rage
Slam at 20+ Rage outside execute, ahead of Mortal Strike (10s cooldown with Improved Slam)
Overpower at 5+ Rage after a dodge or Bloodthrill
Keep Rend up outside execute. Then Execute
Reckless Swings on cooldown, but only when no strike is ready, since it takes a 1s GCD. The next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage and Hamstring filler at 10+, both outside execute
caveats: Spearing Strike only works against Giants and Dragonkin
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
There's no Fury Dragonkin build. Spearing Strike adds only 0.4% to dual-wield Fury and 0.8% to two-hand Fury.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.4 DPS vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing, because the raid already has Battle Shout
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__arms except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeDragonkin, as the class preset's encounter does. Orc since the 2026-11-03 race re-pick (the November 2 notes; Undead from 2026-10-27) (follows its base build, warrior__arms). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull, and the preset's own pull Sunder is the raid's other one.
